items.observation: `RouteMeta.fromMap` uses an `as String?` cast. With `title: 123` in YAML it throws TypeError, not ConfigException; the promise in config.dart:50-51 breaks. Because runCli catches only PrerenderException, the CLI crashes with a stack trace. config_test covers only a wrong top-level type (config_test.dart:85-90).
items.proposed_fix: Move the typed helpers into shared private functions (or have RouteMeta.fromMap throw a ConfigException that names the key); add wrong-type tests for defaults and below routes.
items.closure_criteria: RouteMeta.fromMap throws a ConfigException naming the offending key for wrong-typed values. New wrong-type tests for defaults and below routes pass.

items.observation: 15 files are exported without `show`: helpers that are not user facing (joinUrl sitemap.dart:52, resolveWithinRoot static_server.dart:67, contentTypeFor static_server.dart:81, buildParser cli.dart:22, defaultConfigFile cli.dart:19) become public API; every new top-level function leaks too.
items.proposed_fix: Now add `show` lists that enumerate the current set exactly (non-breaking) and stop the leak; deprecate the accidentally public helpers and remove them in the next major.
items.closure_criteria: lib/flutter_prerender.dart exports each file through a show list that names exactly the intended public set. The accidentally public helpers carry deprecation notes for removal in the next major.

items.observation: `collapsedOntoRoot` finds duplicates by matching the 'produced the same content' prefix of a human-readable warning; if the message is rewritten, exit code 4 silently stops working.
items.proposed_fix: Add a `duplicateOf` (String?) field to RouteResult set at 322-334; the getter reads it; engine_test already pins the current behavior.
items.closure_criteria: RouteResult carries a duplicateOf field set where duplicates are detected and collapsedOntoRoot reads that field instead of warning text. engine_test still passes.

items.observation: `run` mixes the crawl loop, the fixed-route loop and the sitemap and robots writing in ~105 lines; `_renderRoute` takes 7 positional parameters, 3 of them mutable output accumulators.
items.proposed_fix: A private `_RunState` (results, failedRoutes, signatureToRoute); extract `_crawl`, `_writeSitemap`, `_writeRobots`. Behavior stays pinned by engine_test and crawl_test.
items.closure_criteria: engine.run delegates to extracted _crawl, _writeSitemap and _writeRobots methods over a private _RunState and _renderRoute takes no mutable accumulators. engine_test and crawl_test still pass.

items.observation: Default values live in several places: the 4000 ms timeout three times; 'en', '/flutter_bootstrap.js', 0.9, 100 and 'build/web' twice each. When one changes, the YAML path and the constructor path diverge.
items.proposed_fix: Have fromMap fall back to the fields of a single `const PrerenderConfig()` instance; have the engine pass every value explicitly.
items.closure_criteria: fromMap falls back to the defaults of one const PrerenderConfig() and the engine passes every value explicitly. config_test still passes.

items.observation: Exit codes are bare literals scattered across the function; the phrase 'exit code' does not appear in README or action.yml (grep).
items.proposed_fix: Named constants with dartdoc in one place; a table in the README.
items.closure_criteria: Exit codes live in named constants with dartdoc in one place and the README documents the table. cli_test still passes.

items.observation: The 300 ms and 350 ms polling delays and the `--no-sandbox` launch flag used on every run are unjustified.
items.proposed_fix: A named `static const` with a one-sentence rationale; state why the sandbox flag is needed or make it configurable.
items.closure_criteria: browser.dart declares the polling delays as named static const values with a one-sentence rationale. The sandbox flag is justified in a comment or made configurable.

items.observation: `server.listen(instance._handle)` discards the handler's Future. An I/O error inside `_handle` (the client drops the connection mid addStream; happens often when puppeteer closes a page) becomes an uncaught async error in the CLI process. Not reproduced by a run.
items.proposed_fix: Wrap the handler body with `on IOException`/`on HttpException` and close the response silently; extend static_server_test with a cancelled request.
items.closure_criteria: The static server handler wraps its body with on IOException and on HttpException and closes the response quietly. static_server_test covers a cancelled request.

items.observation: Three hand-written escape functions; the HTML ones are covered by dart:convert `HtmlEscape(HtmlEscapeMode.element/attribute)`.
items.proposed_fix: Use HtmlEscape for HTML. Keep the XML escape: HtmlEscape writes the apostrophe as ', not '; example/expected_output pins the output.
items.closure_criteria: html_builder escapes HTML through dart:convert HtmlEscape and keeps the XML escape for the apostrophe. example/expected_output and the builder tests still match.

items.observation: tool/*.dart (2 files, 415 lines) and the pure Dart `example/what_a_crawler_sees.dart` are never analyzed and their format is not checked.
items.proposed_fix: Add `tool` to the format/analyze paths; move the pure Dart example outside the excluded tree or analyze it in the action job.
items.closure_criteria: CI runs format and analyze over tool in addition to lib test bin. The pure Dart example is analyzed in place or by the action job.

items.observation: The engine's 'Enable accessibility' label is written separately in two files; if Flutter changes the label, one falls behind.
items.proposed_fix: A single internal constant; both files use it.
items.closure_criteria: One internal constant holds the Enable accessibility label and both browser.dart and semantics_extractor.dart use it.
